verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Terminal supports an API-based, server-driven integration alongside its SDKs, with a simulated reader for testing. Readers, locations, zones and refunds can be managed via the Stripe API, events arrive through webhooks, and a public OpenAPI spec repository exists. A community developer independently praises the ability to integrate with the API at the terminal level; the probe's OpenAPI 404 at docs.stripe.com paths is offset by the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Terminal-specific API reference endpoints (e.g., server-driven reader actions) in the pack.
